design: Separate restricted area, non-RA paint, midrange, corner threes and above-break/backcourt threes. Preserve coarse-zone and fresh-versus-putback ledgers exactly. Train source make and conditional shot selection on shooter and five defender identities. Compare zero-centered defense shrinkage against a measured blocked-shot exposure feature learned on training games only. No named-player exceptions.
selection: Whole-game five-fold heldout negative log likelihood on older three seasons only, independently by zone/branch; target excluded. Baseline comparison includes coarse models and no-defender fine models. No full-season tracking outcome is used in a heldout feature.
tracking: Audit existing closest-defender and hustle season aggregates for coverage and source scope. Full-season DFG outcomes are descriptive reconstruction evidence only until dated training-only equivalents exist. They must not leak into heldout fitting. PBP blocked-shot identities supply a genuine measured, training-only defensive activity feature.
runtimeGate: Complete source-conditional heldout and reconstruction checks first. Simulation integration requires a clearly selected model and explicit coarse/fine make and shot-choice probability conservation; team PPG may temporarily regress per user authorization, but stays reported. Blocks are already misses and must not be subtracted twice. Source on/off is descriptive, not a causal individual target.
